target.title: fix: avoid malformed TUI hyperlink ranges
target.body:
Related: #100661
Follow-up to #100697

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes edge cases left by the balanced-parentheses TUI hyperlink change where incomplete URL fragments could inherit another URL's OSC8 target, and where punctuation after an unmatched closing parenthesis could remain linked.

## Why This Change Was Made

URL extraction and visible-text range matching now share the same non-empty URL-content rule. Parenthesis trimming stops at the first unmatched close, preserving balanced URL parentheses while excluding the remaining punctuation suffix.

## User Impact

Terminal links keep balanced parentheses in legitimate targets without making malformed or trailing text clickable.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwv3cxf387yceenrhrmk7rr5` (`jade-shrimp`): `src/tui/osc8-hyperlinks.test.ts` — 24 passed.
- Same Testbox: `src/tui/components/hyperlink-markdown.test.ts` — 3 passed through the real `HyperlinkMarkdown` renderer.
- `oxfmt --check` passed for all touched TypeScript files.
- Fresh whole-branch autoreview: clean after three review/fix iterations.
